title: An opening routine that gets cards on sale
target: How to get from a delivery of cards to a shelf customers can buy from, using only shop behaviour the game itself defines.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A shop with at least one shelf placed

steps.do: Unpack and price the cards before you open the shop.
steps.because: cards and their prices are separate objects with dedicated screens rather than one combined value (InteractableCardPriceTag, CheckPriceScreen)

steps.do: Put the priced cards on a shelf a customer can reach.
steps.because: shelf contents are tracked by a manager and the game distinguishes several shelf kinds (ShelfManager, CardShelf, CardItemCombiShelf)

steps.do: Reinvest into shop items and upgrades as well as stock.
steps.because: shop purchases and upgrades are two separate, defined sets of choices (EShopItem, EUpgradeType)

commonMistakes: Opening with empty shelves: a shelf sells only what you put on it.
Leaving cards unpriced, so they cannot be sold.
Spending everything on furniture before you have stock to sell.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
